title: DynamicProcessor — all modes, detector sources, gain modulation
description:
Implement the per-band dynamic processor that wraps envelope followers, soft-knee gain, detector source selection, and applies dynamic gain modulation to a band’s static EQ amount.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/DSP/EnvelopeFollower.h/.cpp (c.1 outputs)
- .abracapocus/SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §4.1–4.5 (detector sources, modes, visualization data fields)
- Source/DSP/ParametricBand.h if present (integration surface only; do not edit)
- .abracapocus/SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §21.3 dynamic EQ verify list

Implement Source/DSP/DynamicProcessor.h and Source/DSP/DynamicProcessor.cpp:
1. Enums: DynamicMode { staticEq, downwardDynamic, upwardDynamic, compression, expansion, transientOnly, sustainOnly, sidechained } and DetectorSource { fullBandInternal, bandLimitedInternal, left, right, mid, side, externalSidechain, inputMinusOutput, transientComponent, sustainComponent } matching §4.1–4.5 wording.
2. DynamicProcessor owns/composes EnvelopeFollower (+ optional TransientSustainSeparator), soft-knee parameters (threshold T, ratio R, knee K, range cap D_max), attack/release, and an optional simple detector bandpass (or coefficient hooks) isolating the region around the EQ band frequency/Q for band-limited internal detection.
3. prepare/reset; process path that, given primary detector sample (and optional external SC / L/R/mid/side taps via a small DetectorContext struct), computes detector level, applies mode-specific gain target, smooths gain, and returns linear gain multiplier (and dB GR) to scale the band’s static boost/cut — staticEq mode returns unity modulation.
4. Mode behavior (document in headers):
   - downward/upward/compression/expansion map signs and ratio application via soft-knee helper;
   - transientOnly/sustainOnly feed detector from transient or sustain component;
   - sidechained uses external sidechain tap when provided, else safe fallback to internal;
   - expansion distinct from simple upward by ratio application above/below threshold as documented in code comments aligned with common dynamic-EQ practice and §4.3 range caps.
5. DynamicVisualizationData POD struct (or nested) for GUI: staticGainDb, maxDynamicRangeDb, currentGainDb, gainReductionHistory sample or ring write API stub, thresholdDb, detectorLevelDb, reactionFlags (transient/sustain/sidechain). Update fields each block or sample as designed; no GUI drawing here.
6. No heap in audio process. Do not edit ParametricBand or CMakeLists.

Do NOT rewrite EnvelopeFollower core math beyond using its public API; extend EnvelopeFollower only if a missing kg setter blocks composition — prefer keeping c.1 API and composing here.
acceptance_criteria: DynamicProcessor exposes DynamicMode covering static, downward/upward dynamic, compression, expansion, transient-only, sustain-only, and sidechained
DetectorSource enum covers full-band internal, band-limited internal, left, right, mid, side, external sidechain, input-minus-output, transient, and sustain components
Processor composes EnvelopeFollower/soft-knee gain and returns smoothed linear gain modulation with no heap allocation in process
DynamicVisualizationData (or equivalent) exposes threshold, detector level, current/dynamic gain, and transient/sustain/sidechain reaction state
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified

allowed: DetectorContext POD carrying channel/SC taps for one sample or block
simple biquad/one-pole bandpass for band-limited detector internal to DynamicProcessor
fixed-size GR history ring for visualization
map compression vs expansion via ratio and sign conventions documented in header
